definition: Stopped the continuous progress of an activity or person.
exampleSentence: The lecturer was speaking when a sudden alarm interrupted him.

definition: The setting or circumstances associated with an event.
exampleSentence: Soft instrumental music was playing in the cafe background.
The power outage occurred while technicians were testing the cables.

definition: Saw an event, typically a crime or accident, take place.
exampleSentence: Several pedestrians witnessed the accident while waiting at the crossing.
The bells were ringing while crowds were gathering outside.

definition: Throughout the course or duration of.
exampleSentence: I took concise notes during the guest speaker's presentation.

definition: Developing or moving forward in space or time.
exampleSentence: The construction work was progressing smoothly until the gale hit.

definition: Occur at or during the same time.
exampleSentence: Her visit was coinciding with the city's annual film gala.

definition: The time during which something continues.
exampleSentence: The team remained on standby for the entire duration of the outage.
Police officers conducted an ongoing inquiry while crowds gathered outside.
